title: Clash Royale Private Server
description: Self-hosted Clash Royale private server (HashRoyale) with a web admin panel: one-click start for MariaDB + game servers, live logs, a CSV editor for game data, and an APK builder that patches the bundled RetroRoyale base client to point at your server, re-signs it, or rebuilds the original client. Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
